methodology:
Kuala Lumpur Kepong is one of Malaysia's largest integrated palm oil + oleochemical operators with ~295,000 hectares planted across Malaysia and Indonesia (97% oil palm, 3% rubber).

3-row breakdown by country / region:
- Peninsular Malaysia (220K acres / ~89K ha) — palm + integrated oleochemical/refining; highest per-acre value due to Peninsular premium + downstream value
- Sabah Malaysia (109K acres / ~44K ha) — pure plantation
- Indonesia (400K acres / ~162K ha) — Belitung Island + Sumatra + Kalimantan diversified

Per-region pricing reflects MPOB 2024-25 + GAPKI 2024-25 benchmarks. Book values allocated by area share of MYR 14,713M Net PP&E.

Note: KLK's book value includes substantial downstream processing infrastructure (oleochemical plants, refineries) — the per-acre book here therefore overstates farmland-only book vs. Peninsular Malaysia plantation peers.
